# Follow-up 17: parts and cost (generated by harness/plans/make_prep_plans.py --label dtp)

Expected and worst: the medians per bucket of the fresh processes of the source sessions times the factors of each arm, plus the median per-part overheads of those sessions. Worst with preemption: every part preempted once at the end of its worst job and relaunched whole. Lifetime: the bound set by the part deadlines (deadline + 30 min).
